name: Poll
description: Allows your site to capture votes on different topics in the form of multiple choice questions.
notes: Formerly Drupal core's Poll module, now maintained as contrib. The documented release 2.0.0-alpha5 is an ALPHA (pre-stable) — API/schema may still change. Defines two content entity types: `poll` (a question with settings) and `poll_choice` (an answer option, referenced by the poll's unlimited-cardinality `choice` field). Votes are NOT entities; they are stored in the `poll_vote` table via the `poll_vote.storage` service. Ships one block plugin, `poll_recent_block` ("Most recent poll"). No config schema and no Drush commands of its own.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 The Poll module allows your site to capture votes on different topics in the form of multiple choice questions.

 Back to top 

 Features 
 
 Create and manage polls 
 Per-poll options for anonymous voting, whether voting is required, open/closed and more 
 A block to display the latest poll 
 Views integration: Create your own blocks and pages 
 Performance: Well integrated with render caching and BigPipe, uses Ajax for voting 
 Fully multilingual, translate polls and choices 
 Well integrated: Configurable fields, Entity references, embed polls with Entity Embed 
 Option to open or close voting to a poll besides the default publishing functionality. 
 
 Back to top 

 Requirements 
 Initiated based on the Drupal 7 Poll core module. Now built for Drupal 8, no other requirements.

 Back to top 

 Documentation 
 Help us write documentation.

 Back to top 

 2.0.x 
 Upgrading from 8.x-1.x to 2.0.x ? Read the change records first.

 2.0.x Is a cleaned up version of 8.x-1.x. and will contain all new features. No new features will be added to 8.x-1.x.

 Back to top

 poll_rest : Provides a REST endpoint to retrieve and submit choices or votes.
